art_direction.identity: A quiet neighborhood café on a cream canvas: espresso-black type, oat-toned bands, hairline rules, soft rounded photographs of cups, pastries, and plates in window light. Restraint over decoration.
art_direction.type: Inter Tight for headings and text — medium/semibold headings with tight tracking; Instrument Serif italic only for one accent word per heading and the menu's group titles.
art_direction.color: One accent: roasted espresso (bg-primary) for the main call to action and the menu card's rules. Everything else is cream canvas, oat surface, ink, and muted text. Never add a second color.
art_direction.signature: The menu card — featured items typeset like a printed café menu with a double hairline border, italic group titles, and dotted leaders running to the prices. Keep it wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Warm, unhurried, specific. Short sentences. No exclamation points, no hype.
